payload.text: gauntlet-protocol-v1: Five-gate battery on the 2024+ holdout, specs frozen at registration (no re-fitting, so walk-forward = one OOS pass; full-history run, trades attributed IS/OOS by entry_date vs 2023-12-31). Gates in fixed fail order: (a1) OOS net>0; (a2) per-trade edge decay > -25% vs IS (fail if IS edge <= 0); (b) 2000-path seeded IID bootstrap of pooled per-trade portfolio contributions (seed=int(strategy_id,16)%2^31), P05 terminal > 1.0 [amends SCHEMA's unfalsifiable 'P05 equity > 0' - equity cannot reach 0 under no-leverage sizing]; (c) ruin = path equity <= 0.5x start, P(ruin) < 5%; (d) deflated Sharpe >= 0.95 [amends vacuous 'DSR > 0'; DSR = PSR(E[max SR]) per Bailey-LdP, trials = sibling group size, variance across trials = sample variance of all group siblings' full-run daily Sharpes, higher-moment PSR corrections]; (e) OOS net > 0 at 2x slippage. Selection (pre-declared): one quarantine slot per sibling group = highest-DSR passer, tie -> lexicographically smallest strategy_id; other passers graveyarded as sibling_not_selected. Compounding convention: contribution = return_net x notional_frac, equity *= 1+c. Engine: pipeline/{engine,stats,gauntlet}.py at the commit carrying this note.
